faq.question: What is the best AI video generator for beginners in 2026?
faq.answer: For beginners, we recommend starting with Alici AI's free tier. It provides access to multiple AI video models (Kling, Runway, Veo) through a single, user-friendly interface—no technical setup required. This lets you experiment with different tools and discover which one matches your creative style before committing to any paid subscription.

faq.question: Is Sora 2 worth the $200/month price tag?
faq.answer: Sora 2 is worth it if your videos generate direct revenue exceeding $200/month—think client work, product ads, or content that drives measurable sales. For hobbyists, social media creators, or those still experimenting, alternatives like Kling 2.6 ($66/month) or Runway ($15-96/month) deliver 80-90% of the quality at a fraction of the cost.

faq.question: Which AI video generator produces the most realistic humans?
faq.answer: Kling 2.6 currently leads in human realism, scoring 4.9/5 in our facial expression and body movement tests. Its Motion Control 2.0 feature allows precise choreography of character movements, and the lip-sync accuracy is industry-leading. Sora 2 comes close (4.7/5), but Kling's specialization gives it an edge for character-focused content.

faq.question: Can I run AI video generators locally on my computer?
faq.answer: Yes, if you have capable hardware. Wan 2.6 is fully open-source and can run locally on systems with an RTX 4090 or better GPU. This eliminates subscription costs and keeps your content completely private. However, local setup requires technical knowledge and upfront hardware investment ($2,000+).

faq.question: How long does AI video generation take?
faq.answer: Generation times vary by tool and complexity. Simple 5-second clips typically take 30 seconds to 2 minutes. Complex cinematic scenes can take 5-15 minutes. Sora 2 tends to be slowest (prioritizing quality), while Kling 2.6 is 2-3x faster for equivalent quality human scenes.
